title: SOS/EOS receiver: current -> TIA -> comparator -> 3V3 logic
notes: 3V3 push-pull SYNC; J1 pin1 remains +5V input, NOT 3V3 input.
S5971: 1=K, 3=A, 2=CASE. Case tied GND. Reverse bias ~1V; no 100MHz claim.
R3 adds positive feedback; TLV3501 SHDN tied low. Full light pulse is outside image ROI.
Threshold/optical amplitude not measured. 5um timing budget is NOT yet passed.
C6 at U1 and C7 at U2. Keep PD_SUM/feedback short; do not connect a long test lead to PD_SUM.
Use short grounded harness for PoC. Long cable requires a differential link change request.
G4: schematic topology unchanged from G2; placements and body-side mapping revised explicitly.
All native ERC/DRC, vendor SPICE and bench remain required; routed artwork is NOT a release.

title: Post-ND reference photodiode and low-pass current amplifier
notes: Preserves R51 four-pin interface; bipolar supply required.
Photodiode nominal reverse bias 5V. Current into cathode is sunk to negative bias; output is positive.
0..100uA input corresponds approximately 0..1V output. Confirm pickoff power before connecting.
RF=10k / CF=100p is a ~159kHz feedback pole; reference and PMT channel delays must be aligned.
This reference signal feeds B02 channel B through its own FDA; not directly a differential ADC input.
G4: schematic topology unchanged from G2; placements and body-side mapping revised explicitly.
All native ERC/DRC, vendor SPICE and bench remain required; routed artwork is NOT a release.

title: H10720-20 current TIA and DC-coupled differential ADC driver
notes: PMT current is modeled as a sink at PMT_I; verify output polarity with manufacturer/sample.
RF/CF are solder-selected gain pairs: baseline100k/2.2p; alternatives10k/6.8p and1k/22p.
AD8138 differential gain=806/499=1.6152, offset=0.5V. 0..1V TIA maps to +/-0.8076V differential.
ADC full scale assumed2Vpp differential, SENSE=GND. ADC_VCM is supplied by B02 (nominal0.9V).
OPA828 and FDA decouplers must sit at their power pins. Do not parallel a LOG amplifier at PMT_I.
PMT socket mechanical pattern is provisional: inherited pads are NOT manufacturer-approved sockets.
G4: schematic topology unchanged from G2; placements and body-side mapping revised explicitly.
All native ERC/DRC, vendor SPICE and bench remain required; routed artwork is NOT a release.
